svg.text: From an issuer-signed credential to a verified public proof
Immutable record · issuer role check · issuance
Verifier opens link or scans QR
Fallback to configured RPC + public IPFS
Read ipfs:// URI through HTTP gateway
API failure is not invalid proof
Public manifest bytes · CID ≠ credential hash
Direct RPC + gateway · no Credora API
Blue: wallet / client flow · Purple: API operations · Green: public proof · Orange: operational state / availability · Dashed: optional paths or source reads
